Use case: scientific-educational
Asset type: one independent square illustration for an English vocabulary memory card.
Exact target sense: note; n.; 笔记.
Primary scene: A student makes pictorial notes in an open notebook while observing a real potted bean plant beside it. Notebook pages contain only small clear observational drawings of the same plant, leaf shape, roots and sprout sequence arranged in concise rows; a pencil is touching a newly drawn leaf. View over the shoulder makes the notebook central. Absolutely no letters, numbers, words or imitation writing.
Style/medium: hand-painted gouache with subtle colored-pencil texture on warm off-white paper. Soft natural light, muted green, blue and coral.
Composition: one coherent clear scene centered within middle 70 percent with generous empty margins, fully visible and legible at small card size.
Constraints: no letters, words, numerals, labels, logos, watermarks, borders or card UI. Semantic clarity for precisely this meaning is highest priority. Do not render any prompt text.
